Hi Sarah, Pierre, Akio —

Thanks again for the interest and for coordinating across regions. We'd love to run a 45-minute product demo + Q&A next week and make sure your execs from US/EU/APAC can join (I realize the timezone math is painful). Proposed slots below (all converted for convenience):

- Tue 22 Jun — 9:00am PDT / 12:00pm EDT / 6:00pm CEST / 1:00am JST (Wed)
- Wed 23 Jun — 3:00pm PDT / 6:00pm EDT / 12:00am CEST (Thu) / 7:00am JST (Thu)
- Thu 24 Jun — 11:00am PDT / 2:00pm EDT / 8:00pm CEST / 3:00am JST (Fri)

Notes: US/EU daylight savings are different times of year — currently the conversions above are correct for June (EDT / CEST). If any of the execs prefer mornings in Japan, we can swap to an earlier US slot and shift the agenda to 30 minutes.

Can you each indicate availability and which slot you'd prefer? I can send a calendar invite once we lock a time. Attaching a short agenda and a requirements checklist.

Agenda (attached): Overview (10m), Architecture & Multi-region routing (15m), Performance/SLAs (10m), Q&A + next steps (10m).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0178

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options. For Acme's side, our Head of Platform (I will loop them in if needed) prefers mornings EDT. The Tue 22 Jun noon EDT would be perfect, but I see that falls at 1:00am JST which won't work for Akio.

Is there any chance of a 10:00am EDT / 7:00am PDT slot the same week? That would be 3:00pm CEST and 10:00pm JST — still late for Akio but better than 1am. If Akio can't do late evening, we can also do a split: short exec touchpoint for EU/US and a follow-up technical deep-dive with APAC the following day.

If splitting is easier, let's propose:
- Exec session (US/EU): Tue 22 Jun 10:00am EDT / 3:00pm CEST
- Tech deep-dive (APAC-friendly): Wed 23 Jun 9:00am JST / Tue 23 Jun 8:00pm CEST / Tue 23 Jun 3:00pm EDT

Open to what works for your SEs and execs.

Best,
Sarah
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:30:00 GMT
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference - Multi-region coordination

Looping in Evelyn (solutions) and Rishi (VP). For scheduling constraints: Rishi is only available Tue/Wed mornings Pacific next week — he can join Tue 10:00am EDT (which is Tue 7:00am PDT) but prefers to avoid very late-night calls. Evelyn — if we do an exec session + separate tech dive, we can shorten the exec to 30 minutes and run a deeper 60-minute session tailored to Akio's APAC schedule.

Evelyn, can you confirm if your team can do:
- Tue 22 Jun 10:00am EDT (exec, 30 mins)
- Wed 23 Jun 9:00am JST (tech deep-dive, 60 mins)

Also a quick note about DST: the EU/US offsets look right for June (EDT = UTC-4, CEST = UTC+2). We should call out timezone in the calendar invite explicitly with both cities to avoid confusion when invites travel across calendar systems.

-Jonas
From: Akio Tanaka <akio.tanaka@kyoto.co.jp>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>
Cc: Pierre Dubois <pierre.dubois@legrand.fr>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:10:00 GMT
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference - Multi-region coordination

Hello all —

Thank you for checking times. Akio here. Late night sessions (after 11:00pm JST) are difficult for our execs. The split approach works best for us: we can join a technical deep-dive on Wed 23 Jun at 9:00am JST (which I believe is Wed 00:00 UTC / Tue 8:00pm EDT). I can have two engineers attend for the deep dive.

If you confirm the exec touchpoint is a shorter 30-minute session for US/EU only, we will catch the recording and follow up with questions.

Regards,

Great—thanks everyone for the quick replies and flexibility. Plan below:

1) Exec touchpoint (US/EU only) — Tue 22 Jun 10:00am EDT / 7:00am PDT / 3:00pm CEST — 30 minutes.
2) Tech deep-dive (APAC + EU/US tech reps) — Wed 23 Jun 9:00am JST / Tue 23 Jun 8:00pm CEST / Tue 23 Jun 3:00pm EDT — 60 minutes.

I've just sent calendar invites with explicit city timezones in the title and included both agenda and the requirements checklist in the invite. Invites include a recording option and will be set to attach the recording to the event notes for anyone who needs to watch later.

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm execs for the 30-minute slot (names) so we can include them on the invite.
- Akio: confirm the two engineers who will join the deep-dive.
- Evelyn: we'll need a slide or two on multi-region routing and a short demo of the failover flow (10 mins).

Thanks — looking forward to both sessions.

Marissa Cole
